name: Genetec Technology Berhad
overview: Genetec在2026年出售了其在Citaglobal Genetec BESS的50%股权，退出电池储能系统业务。公司未公告其他业务板块的扩张、新合约或缩减事项。
overview_en: In 2026, Genetec disposed of its 50% equity interest in Citaglobal Genetec BESS, exiting the battery energy storage system business. No other expansions, new contracts, or reductions were announced for the business segments.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面出售了电池储能系统合资公司的股权。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the company disposed of its equity interest in a battery energy storage system joint venture this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以RM1.00出售Citaglobal Genetec BESS Sdn Bhd的50%股权（250,000股）予Citaglobal New Energy Sdn Bhd，并转让RM2,244,675.71的公司间结余。
actions.text_en: Disposed of its 50% equity interest (250,000 shares) in Citaglobal Genetec BESS Sdn Bhd to Citaglobal New Energy Sdn Bhd for RM1.00, and transferred an intercompany balance of RM2,244,675.71.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 退出电池储能系统业务，出售Citaglobal Genetec BESS的50%股权。
model_changes.text_en: Exited the battery energy storage system business by disposing of its 50% equity interest in Citaglobal Genetec BESS.
